title: When discipline keeps thinning out under pressure
issueStatement: Good intention is present, but the pattern cannot hold. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru places discipline inside remembrance, restraint, and inner victory instead of image management. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer.
actionPrompt: Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
